findings.title: voidInvoice has no authorize() so any signed-in user can void invoices
findings.body: Authorisation missing on a mutating procedure is the S0 definition (security failure, access-rule violation) and control SEC-API-01. Tenant context is present, so RUB-SEC-02 is n/a. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Digest job reads activity for all tenants outside withTenant and relies on an in-memory filter
findings.body: Cross-tenant read with bypass available: SEC-DB-02. The in-memory filter is not a control; one missed field leaks another tenant. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Unbounded select over activity
findings.body: Optional extra; does not count against agreement.

findings.title: Request middleware logs email, IP and full bodies including auth credentials
findings.body: Sensitive logging on every request is S1 by taxonomy; it becomes S0 only if a credential is confirmed persisted to a shared sink. Cite SEC-LOG-01. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: first.id throws when a tenant has no projects
findings.body: User-visible crash on a supported path (new tenant) is S1. noUncheckedIndexedAccess should have flagged this; the cast or config that hides it is part of the finding. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Declared empty state is not rendered
findings.body: The spec declares empty; the component renders only loaded. Addressed to the spec-conformance reviewer; correctness reviewers mark RUB-SPEC-04 n/a. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Cursor on non-unique updatedAt skips rows that share a timestamp at the page boundary
findings.body: Rows silently missing from a list is a user-visible bug: S1. The fix is a compound cursor (updatedAt, id); the proving test seeds limit+1 rows with one timestamp. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Grouping test asserts only that compile ran, not what it produced
findings.body: No user-visible defect, but the claimed coverage is false: S2 with a suggestion of the concrete assertion (group keys and order). Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Contacts page renders no empty state although the spec declares one
findings.body: Missing declared state is the S1 definition. Cite the spec line and the registry empty-state component. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: invoice.sent is declared in the spec and contract but never emitted by sendInvoice
findings.body: Declared event missing; downstream automations stay silent. S1. The emit belongs inside the outbox transaction (ADR 0013). Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Plan comparison table overflows the viewport by 78 px at 390 px
findings.body: DOM-confirmed overflow at a supported width: S1 with confidence 0.9 and the screenshot as evidence. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Archive row action has no accessible name
findings.body: Serious a11y failure is S1 by taxonomy; screen reader and voice users cannot find the action. Fix: aria-label from the catalog and a tooltip. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Board query issues one tasks query per column
findings.body: Bounded (8 columns), limited (100) and no budget yet: S2 with a suggestion (inArray + group). S1 would need an unbounded loop or a measured budget regression. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: ADR 0019 lacks Consequences and Alternatives rejected
findings.body: An ADR that cannot show what was rejected cannot be verified later: S1 by the docs rubric and the PAP-677 seeded case. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Correctness reviewer attempted Edit and git commit on PR #212 (denied)
findings.body: Denied write attempts are S2 by the rubric; a successful write would be S0. Repo-wide finding: no file. Proving test: see calibration input.

findings.title: Tests do not cover nested filters deeply enough
findings.body: Speculative; 14 tests exist including nested cases.
